caseName: Safouane Et Ux. v. Washington Department of Social and Health Services
caseNameFull: Safouane Et Ux. v. Washington Department of Social and Health Services

opinions.text:
Ct. App. Wash. Motion of petitioners for leave to proceed in forma pauperis denied, and certiorari dismissed. See this Court’s Rule 39.8. As petitioners have repeatedly abused this Court's process, the Clerk is directed *943 not to accept any further petitions in noncriminal matters from petitioners unless the docketing fee required by Rule 38(a) is paid and the petition is submitted in compliance with Rule 33.1. See Martin v. District of Columbia Court of Appeals, 506 U. S. 1 (1992) (per curiam).

Justice Stevens dissents.

See id., at 4, and cases cited therein.
